validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="red">
  <state id="red">
    <onentry>
      <send event="timer.green" delay="3s" sendid="send_timer_green"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="timer.green" target="green"/>
  </state>
  <final id="green"/>
</scxml>

notes: the W3C SCXML 1.0 schema rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`: Attribute 'sendid' is not allowed for this element
diagnostics.help: did you mean `id`? a `<send>` declares its ID with `id`; `sendid` is how `<cancel>` refers to that ID
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`)
